connector.name: Google Drive by us-all
connector.registryDescription: Google Drive + Workspace MCP - Docs, Sheets, Slides, Shared Drives, Labels, Approvals, DWD
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package google-drive-mcp. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the us-all account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

env.name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID
env.description: OAuth client ID. Required for OAuth refresh-token auth method.

env.name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET
env.description: OAuth client secret. Required for OAuth refresh-token auth method.

env.name: GOOGLE_REFRESH_TOKEN
env.description: OAuth refresh token. Required for OAuth refresh-token auth method.

env.name: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS
env.description: Path to service account JSON key. Required for SA + DWD auth method (alternative to OAuth).

env.name: GOOGLE_IMPERSONATE_USER
env.description: Workspace user email to impersonate (DWD). Required when using service account auth.

env.name: GOOGLE_DRIVE_SCOPES
env.description: Comma-separated OAuth scopes. Defaults are read-only; write mode broadens Drive/Docs scopes as needed.

env.name: GOOGLE_DRIVE_ALLOW_WRITE
env.description: Set to 'true' to enable write tools. Default read-only.

env.name: GD_TOOLS
env.description: Comma-separated category allowlist. Default: all categories enabled.
